entities.summary: Myrto Azina Chronides (1961-2021) was a Greek Cypriot writer. She was born in Nicosia and started writing at a young age. She studied at the Pancyprian Gymnasium, before going on to medical school. She also studied at the University of Bonn in Euskirchen and has worked in public health in Cyprus.
